closed_findings.evidence: Fresh real 23-byte interserver/32-byte SQL positive bundles and independent real file/stdin controls; 24/32/33 interserver and 33 SQL rejection before assets/directory via spies; 58 runtime +18 package cases rerun. SQL32 is conservative application policy; inspected SQL connection fields are native std::string, not a newly claimed fixed 32-byte native array.

logic_errors.authority: Guide:55-56,114-120 and ADR:35-39 require world-bound materialization and readback. This is an offline destination-inode identity defect, not absent future world locking.
logic_errors.repro: root_replacement_after_open: after real INCOMPLETE write, rename the owned root aside and replace requested path with an existing world tree. API returns success while requested target has no manifest. Parent-path replacement also returns success with requested destination absent; fd anchoring correctly avoids writing into replacement parent, but success binding is wrong.
logic_errors.title: Retained root fd is not rebound to the requested destination before successful publication

logic_errors.authority: Guide:117-120 defines marker removal as offline completion. This is not an atomic-rename demand, nor a claim that launch authority exists. Failed durability must not look like completed offline output.
logic_errors.qualification: No API/CLI success was reported by this fsync-failure probe; defect is filesystem publication frontier.
logic_errors.repro: final_directory_fsync_failure injects a real directory-fsync exception after manifest readback. API correctly raises, but manifest remains and INCOMPLETE is absent: same on-disk completion predicate as a successful bundle.
logic_errors.title: Publication marker disappears before fallible final durability and close steps

logic_errors.authority: Guide:114-117 explicitly promises original exception propagation; offline cleanup errors must not replace origin identity.
logic_errors.repro: original_exception_with_close_fault: raise a specific KeyboardInterrupt after actual LICENSE write and raise OSError from final root close after actually closing the fd. Caller receives OSError, not original KeyboardInterrupt; original only remains as context.
logic_errors.title: Cleanup close fault replaces the original BaseException

logic_errors.authority: Pinned char header/reader, login handshake loginclif.cpp:402,416 and char_logif.cpp:830. Source-derived config capacities are part of offline contract. World label may remain long only if native display value is independently explicit/bounded; do not imply SQL/world identity from native display name.
logic_errors.repro: literal_alias_and_native_server_name builds a genuine 37-byte permitted production label and emits the entire label as server_name. Native reader safestrncpy uses a 20-byte array (19 payload bytes) and would truncate it; no native program was run.
logic_errors.title: Allowed long production labels are emitted beyond native server_name capacity

logic_errors.authority: Guide:40-43 literal absolute no-symlink paths; explicit review acceptance requires unsafe aliases refused. This probe shows spelling-contract mismatch, not symlink traversal or external isolation compromise.
logic_errors.repro: literal_alias_and_native_server_name passes physical scratch-parent/./test and scratch-parent/./input.json through real CLI; it returns 0 and creates the bundle. argparse Path and subsequent Path conversion discard dot components before literal_parts sees them.
logic_errors.title: CLI normalizes dot and repeated-separator spellings before literal-path validation

logic_errors.authority: Explicit review contract requires malformed UTF-8 rejection. json.loads(raw bytes) auto-detects alternate encodings; decode strict UTF-8 before JSON parsing if UTF-8-only is the intended contract.
logic_errors.repro: invalid_utf8_alternate_encoding: valid schema encoded as UTF-16 or UTF-32 does not decode as UTF-8, yet real file and stdin CLI each return 0 and publish a full bundle. ASCII values remain restricted and no values leak.
logic_errors.title: Private decoder accepts invalid UTF-8 via JSON automatic UTF-16/32 detection

image.limitation: Image hash pair brackets finalization, not the earliest test run; scoped package test inspected its archive independently.

review: fresh independent completed offline private-runtime builder review
scope_limits: No full native configuration/NPC/database body/cache parser execution or fixture parity.
No SQL/schema/bootstrap/interserver or player account writes.
No endpoint DNS, reachability, isolation, ownership proof, exclusive world lock or trusted executor.
No Docker/podman/server/database/network/world/provider/gateway operations; no copied/private binary execution.
Package test native help/version/refusal only, after fresh fixed NAR attestation and inspecting pre-init startup guard.
No raw DB image/bootstrap SQL artifact approval, native ACK/gameplay, Rust/UI integration, full project gate or coverage claim.

Race/fault interleavings are deterministic same-user monkeypatches around actual fd/stream operations and full public bundles; not proven adversarial different-UID exploits or disk/power-loss simulations.
Input foreign-owner branch exercised by UID-only fstat metadata injection on real owner-private input fd, not creation of inaccessible different-UID private credentials.
Initial independent harness readback fault fired at public LICENSE read rather than output readback. Corrected to exact owned output-fd path and rerun; that failed harness iteration is not a finding.
Original extra harness AST parsing error fixed in scratch and rerun.

security_concerns.authority: No retained identity from mkdir or root fstat owner/mode checks. Guide:55-56,108-120 and proposed ADR:35-39 require no overwrite/newly-owned private output.
security_concerns.repro: root_replacement_before_open in scratch harness: after exclusive mkdir and before world open, rename new tree aside and substitute an existing 0755 tree with a sentinel. Real full bundle succeeds, writes private config into substituted tree, keeps root 0755, and leaves original newly-created root empty.
security_concerns.scope: Supported offline filesystem publication; no native execution or endpoint ownership assumptions.
security_concerns.title: Root substitution after mkdir writes private bundle into a pre-existing nonprivate tree

security_concerns.authority: write_at calls read_at with private=False; guide:108-112 and ADR:35-39 claim private files. Permissions must be checked on the actual readback descriptor.
security_concerns.repro: output_leaf_mode_change: chmod real generated conf/inter_athena.conf to 0644 between exclusive stream close and output readback. Actual native private config content remains unchanged; builder returns success and removes marker with world-readable config. No values copied to evidence.
security_concerns.scope: Same-user controlled interleaving, not a demonstrated hostile different-UID exploit.
security_concerns.title: Output readback does not enforce owner-private leaf metadata

suggestions.recommendation: Require width>0 and height>0 separately before product check. Native reader rejects either nonpositive dimension; helper currently accepts both negative. Actual fixed attested caches independently passed positive dimension/cell/frontier checks, so this is not a demonstrated malformed real-bundle acceptance.

summary: RUNTIME-WIRE-001 verified closed; ordinary real bundle/closure/scoped tests pass, but eight reproduced offline I/O/input/native-field findings prevent approval.
